question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution:
The erroneous spelling is "**Accommadation**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the **correct spelling** and meaning of the** word**.

 
 
• Accommodation: 

 a room, group of rooms, or building in which someone may live or stay.

 
 
• **Example**: *The **accommodation **__in the hotel arranged by the hosts of the conference was unpleasant, to say the least.*
 
 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning** of the other words.

 
 
• **correspondence**: 

 a close similarity, connection, or equivalence.
 
 
• 
 **campaign**: 
 an organized course of action to achieve a goal.
 
 
 
• **experiment**: a scientific procedure is undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.
 
 
 
• All the other words are spelled correctly.
